+- **Mock-data runs use the model's real vocabulary.** Megatron mock data used to size every model for a 131,072-token vocabulary; each model config now sets its real `vocab_size`, so embeddings, output layer, and logits have their true size. Mock-data throughput and memory are therefore not comparable with earlier releases ([#1249](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1249)).
+- **Megatron-only example material moved under `examples/megatron/`.** For example `examples/deepseek-v4/` is now `examples/megatron/models/deepseek-v4/`, and `examples/moe_package/` is now `examples/megatron/guides/moe_package/`; `examples/mlperf/` and `examples/hardware_configs/` stay where they were. Update scripts that name the old paths ([#1130](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1130)).
+- **Some environment switches are now config keys, and the old variables do nothing.** `PRIMUS_FUSED_QK_RMSNORM_ROPE` is replaced by `use_turbo_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope` ([#1247](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247)); `PRIMUS_TURBO_CROSS_ENTROPY` and `PRIMUS_TURBO_CE_OVERWRITE_INPUT` by `use_turbo_cross_entropy` and `turbo_ce_overwrite_input` ([#1245](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1245)); the MoE gather-quantization variables by `moe_permute_quant_fusion`, `moe_backward_permute_quant_fusion`, and `moe_skip_identity_sort` ([#1241](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1241)).
+- **Transformer Engine fused cross entropy reuses the logits buffer by default** (`te_ce_overwrite_input: true`), so after the loss backward the logits tensor holds its gradient. Set it to `false` when the same logits feed anything else in the step, such as a distillation or auxiliary loss, metrics, or hooks ([#1287](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1287)).
+- **TorchTitan uses a Triton fused AdamW by default** (`optimizer.use_triton_fused_adam: true`). Checkpoints stay interchangeable with `torch.optim.AdamW`; set the flag to `false` to go back to it. Reading `optimizer.state` directly between steps now shows stale `step` values ([#1233](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1233)).
+- **Turbo grouped GEMM expects expandable segments.** Primus warns when `use_turbo_grouped_gemm` is on without `expandable_segments:True`, and a runner hook stops the launch when `expandable_segments:True` is requested but not in effect on the PyTorch build ([#1257](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1257)).
+
+#### New features
+
+- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (`model_type: glm5_next`): KDA linear attention, DSA sparse attention, and manifold-constrained hyper-connections with a 288-expert MoE, an MI355X BF16 recipe, and online loading of the released Hugging Face checkpoint for any TP / EP / PP layout ([#1230](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1230)). Packed sequences now run under context parallelism ([#1265](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1265)) and text-only checkpoint exports load ([#1254](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1254)). Training was validated on an 8-layer proxy; the full 45-layer model was checked forward-only against SGLang, and its DSA indexer is frozen.
+- **ZAYA1-8B FP8 recipes** for MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X (`fp8: hybrid`, tensorwise scaling, accurate from a cold start) and an MI325X BF16 recipe ([#1269](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1269)); the MI355X micro-batch sizes now fill that GPU's memory ([#1279](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1279)).
+- **HunyuanWorld-Mirror post-training**, stage 1 (geometry heads) and stage 2 (Gaussian head), with MI355X configs launched through `train posttrain`. The upstream trainer is the new `third_party/HunyuanWorld-Mirror-rocm` submodule; Primus applies ROCm fixes at runtime ([#1242](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1242)).
+- **MiniMax-M3 on MegaMoE.** The fused MegaMoE expert layer accepts MiniMax-M3's `swigluoai` activation and matches the DeepEP path's loss ([#1243](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1243)).
+- **Opt-in fusions:** Primus-Turbo fused cross entropy for TP1 training ([#1245](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1245)); FlyDSL Q/K RMSNorm + RoPE and residual RMSNorm + MXFP4 QKV fusions for GPT-OSS ([#1208](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1208)), with the fused Q/K RMSNorm + RoPE now also covering head dimension 128 ([#1247](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247)); and gradient reduce-scatter on the GPU's copy engines (`MEGATRON_GRAD_REDUCE_BACKEND=rccl_sdma`, which needs an RCCL build with CE ReduceScatter) ([#1207](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1207)).
+- **MI455X FP8 hybrid LoRA SFT proxies** for Llama-2-70B, Qwen2.5-72B, and Qwen3-235B-A22B on one GPU ([#1248](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1248)).

issue_comments.body: @peterjunpark This is the PR to update the Primus docs to v26.9. Please review it. Thank you

Follow-up on the PR Pundit review, addressed in 7263d1b3:

Fixed
- 1: the "Verifying the stack in an image" commands now use rocm/primus:v26.9.
- 2: the installation README now treats apex as the exception to the same-ROCm pin rule.
- 10: the MaxText profiling tag example is now v26.9_llama2_7b.
- 11: the README pip-install examples now use v26.9.0 / 26.9.0.
- 14: restored release/v26.8 as the MaxText release that made the TF extras opt-in.
- 15: linked #1286 for the TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0 default.
- 16: reworded the flydsl pin note.

Not addressed in this PR
- 3, 8, 9, 17: these are comments in Dockerfile.*-v26.9, which are recorded copies of the Dockerfiles that built the release images, so they stay as built. Fixes belong in the CI source Dockerfiles.
- 5: this would change the image build, so it's out of scope for a docs PR.
- 4: this is a limitation of install_parity.py that predates this PR. It's a follow-up for the tool.
- 6, 7, 12: Pundit's own verification already found these don't apply.
- 13: this is a refactor of setup.sh with no user-facing effect.

reviews.body:
<!-- pr-pundit-live:primus-1375-6e47a047 -->
### PR Pundit review
17 findings, 4 as comments on the diff below.

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | Image verification commands pull and inspect v26.8: this PR left both `docker run` tags un-bumped | `docs/01-getting-started/release-notes.md:636` |
| 2 | 🟠 | Installation README says apex must match torch's ROCm, contradicting the new ROCm 10.3 apex pin | `tools/installation/README.md:287` ↓ |
| 3 | 🟠 | JAX image's `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` comment describes TE 2.17, `jax_rocm7_plugin` and a nonexistent RCCL override | `.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.jax-v26.9:229` ↓ |
| 4 | 🟠 | Parity `--check` reports torchvision/torchaudio drift as OK: this PR files identical pins as documented divergences | `tools/release_docs/install_parity_rules.json:36` ↓ |
| 5 | 🟠 | JAX image build fetches full clones of unused PyTorch submodules: this PR restored `--recurse-submodules` clone | `.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.jax-v26.9:372` ↓ |
| 6 | 🟠 | JAX TE wheel built for ROCm 10.2 nightly runs on a ROCm 10.3 image, risking ABI breakage | `.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.jax-v26.9:260` |
| 7 | 🔵 | Validation headings claim v26.8 runtime validation while scripts install unvalidated v26.9 nightly pins | `tools/installation/README.md:274` |
| 8 | 🔵 | `--reinstall` comment cites pip 26.2.1 and omits urllib3 CVEs while the stage builds 26.2.2 | `.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.primus-v26.9:137` |
| 9 | 🔵 | Datasets cap comment cites `pyarrow==21.0.0`, but the image force-installs `pyarrow==23.0.1` | `.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.primus-v26.9:200` |
| 10 | 🔵 | Profiling example pairs `maxtext-v26.9` image with `v26.8_llama2_7b` tag: this PR bumped only `IMAGE` | `docs/02-user-guide/jax-maxtext-training.md:425` |
| 11 | 🔵 | README pip-install section installs Primus 26.2.0rc1 while Quick Start pins 26.9.0 | `README.md:83` |
| 12 | 🔵 | v26.9 MaxText notes still tell users to drop `pure_nnx_decoder`, an issue fixed in v26.8 | `docs/02-user-guide/jax-maxtext-training.md:37` |
| 13 | 🔵 | Site-packages lookup heredoc now copied in four patch helpers: this PR added two more copies | `tools/installation/setup.sh:361` |
| 14 | 🔵 | JAX setup comment and guide claim MaxText `release/v26.9` made extras opt-in; v26.8 did | `tools/installation-jax/setup.sh:335` |
| 15 | 🔵 | New `TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0` default explained only as 'memory issues', with no removal condition | `tools/installation/env.sh:164` |
| 16 | 🔵 | Readers can't tell what 'It is restated' refers to: this PR deleted the flydsl-pin antecedent | `tools/installation/README.md:246` |
| 17 | 🔵 | Comgr workaround comment describes a same-RUN hardlink while code creates a symlink in another RUN | `.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.primus-v26.9:250` |

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: Image verification commands pull and inspect v26.8: this PR left both `docker run` tags un-bumped
`docs/01-getting-started/release-notes.md:636`

Both `docker run` commands in 'Verifying the stack in an image' (lines 636 and 642) still use `rocm/primus:v26.8`, while every other current-image tag was bumped to v26.9. Users copying these commands inspect the previous release's image. Bump both to `rocm/primus:v26.9`.

**Who is affected:** Users following the 'Verifying the stack in an image' section of the v26.9 release notes.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

<details><summary>Nits and less certain findings (12)</summary>

**6. JAX TE wheel built for ROCm 10.2 nightly runs on a ROCm 10.3 image, risking ABI breakage** (`.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.jax-v26.9:260`)

`TE_VERSION=2.19.0.dev0+rocm10.2.0a20261002` sits on `THE_ROCK_VERSION=10.3.0a20261026`, with JAX plugins on rocm10.3.0a20261026, yet the release notes say TE is built against the image's nightly. The bare-metal script reproduces the mismatch, and the README's same-ROCm-build rule was weakened. This is a cross-nightly ABI risk: document it as a deliberate divergence or align the builds.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: head release-notes.md:148 says TE 2.19.0.dev0 is tagged rocm10.2.0a20261002 while the image's ROCm and JAX plugins are 10.3.0a20261026; the 'built against that nightly' sentence is in the v26.8 section (:342), where it was true. tools/installation-jax/README.md likewise says the TE pairing 'is the image's, and it is kept', so the divergence is already documented as the candidate asks._

**7. Validation headings claim v26.8 runtime validation while scripts install unvalidated v26.9 nightly pins** (`tools/installation/README.md:274`)

`tools/installation/README.md:274`, `tools/installation-jax/README.md:212` and the guides still say 'Runtime-validated for v26.8', but the scripts now install untested v26.9 nightly pins (ROCm 10.2 nightly, torch 2.16 pre-release, apex for ROCm 10.3). The README itself says 'The v26.9 pins have not been through a bare-metal run yet', so the 'deliberate, tested deviation' wording is no longer backed. Mark the v26.9 pins as unvalidated in these headings.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: Each 'Runtime-validated for v26.8' caveat already says 'The v26.9 pins have not been through a bare-metal run yet': tools/installation/README.md:274-282, tools/installation-jax/README.md:212-218, bare-metal-installation.md:632 and bare-metal-installation-jax.md:286. The quoted 'deliberate, tested deviation' sentence (README.md:219) is about Primus-Turbo's --no-deps install, not the validation heading, and was already on the base at line 228._

**8. `--reinstall` comment cites pip 26.2.1 and omits urllib3 CVEs while the stage builds 26.2.2** (`.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.primus-v26.9:137`)

The comment justifying `--reinstall` says the re-vendored wheel 'shares the 26.2.1 version string', but `ARG PIP_VERSION=26.2.2`; the same stale text is in `Dockerfile.jax-v26.9:167`. Reword it to reference `${PIP_VERSION}`. The adjacent comment also lists only the msgpack/setuptools IDs and omits the urllib3 CVEs that pip_builder now re-vendors.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers reading the v26.9 release Dockerfiles; the image build is unaffected.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**9. Datasets cap comment cites `pyarrow==21.0.0`, but the image force-installs `pyarrow==23.0.1`** (`.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.primus-v26.9:200`)

The new comment says `datasets` stays at 5.0.1 because 'Primus pins pyarrow==21.0.0'. That pin is real (`requirements.txt:24`), but this image overrides it with `pyarrow==23.0.1` (line 623). The release snapshot records 23.0.1. The cap is still correct, because 23.0.1 is also below the `pyarrow>=24` that `datasets` 5.1.0 needs. Cite the pyarrow version the image actually installs.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers reading the v26.9 primus Dockerfile when bumping datasets or pyarrow.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**10. Profiling example pairs `maxtext-v26.9` image with `v26.8_llama2_7b` tag: this PR bumped only `IMAGE`** (`docs/02-user-guide/jax-maxtext-training.md:425`)

The neighbouring IMAGE line now says maxtext-v26.9, but the TAG example still reads 'e.g. v26.8_llama2_7b'. Bump it to v26.9 so the paired example is consistent.

**Who is affected:** Readers copying the standalone Docker profiling example in the MaxText guide.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**11. README pip-install section installs Primus 26.2.0rc1 while Quick Start pins 26.9.0** (`README.md:83`)

The 'Install as a Python package' section of `README.md` still shows `git+...Primus.git@v26.2.0rc1` and `primus==26.2.0rc1` (lines 83, 86), while the Quick Start pip line now pins `primus==26.9.0`. This stale example predates this PR: the base already had `26.2.0rc1` there alongside `26.8.0`. Consider bumping both to `v26.9.0`/`26.9.0` while the release docs are being updated.

**Origin:** pre-existing

**Who is affected:** Readers who copy the pip-install example from the README get an old release candidate instead of v26.9.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**12. v26.9 MaxText notes still tell users to drop `pure_nnx_decoder`, an issue fixed in v26.8** (`docs/02-user-guide/jax-maxtext-training.md:37`)

'Important notes for v26.9' still includes 'Drop `pure_nnx_decoder` from local configs', which was fixed in v26.8 (#1228). The stale note sits next to the real v26.9 `retry_when_tokens_dropped` note and dilutes it. Remove it.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: In head docs/02-user-guide/jax-maxtext-training.md the note sits under the explicit sub-heading 'If you are moving from v26.7 or earlier:', separate from the v26.9 notes. It is guidance for users upgrading across v26.8, where the key was removed, not a stale v26.9 known issue._

**Related past reviews:** [#1052](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1052) on `docs/02-user-guide/jax-maxtext-training.md`

**13. Site-packages lookup heredoc now copied in four patch helpers: this PR added two more copies** (`tools/installation/setup.sh:361`)

New `patch_torch_cpp_extension` and `patch_fla_autotune_key` each copy the same 8-line Python heredoc that scans `sysconfig` purelib/platlib, giving four copies with `patch_apex_cxx20` and `patch_te_ck_jit` (lines 343, 364, 438, 825). Extract a single `site_file <relpath>` helper and call it from each patch function.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers of `tools/installation/setup.sh`; no runtime effect.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**14. JAX setup comment and guide claim MaxText `release/v26.9` made extras opt-in; v26.8 did** (`tools/installation-jax/setup.sh:335`)

The comment 'release/v26.8 made the TensorFlow, TFDS, seqio and JetStream extras opt-in' was mechanically changed to 'release/v26.9', which misstates when the change happened. Restore v26.8, e.g. 'Since release/v26.8 the ... extras are opt-in'.

**Who is affected:** Readers of the bare-metal JAX installer script and its guide.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**15. New `TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0` default explained only as 'memory issues', with no removal condition** (`tools/installation/env.sh:164`)

The new default is explained only as 'alongside Primus #1286, to resolve memory issues' in `env.sh`, `bare-metal-installation.md`, the installation README and `Dockerfile.primus-v26.9`. None say what the flag disables, what symptom it avoids, or when it can be removed. State the code path and symptom, link the issue, and give a removal condition.

**Who is affected:** Bare-metal users and maintainers who need to know why `TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0` is set and when to remove it.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**16. Readers can't tell what 'It is restated' refers to: this PR deleted the flydsl-pin antecedent** (`tools/installation/README.md:246`)

The edit removed 'Primus-Turbo itself now pins `flydsl==…`', leaving 'It is restated because Turbo is installed with `--no-deps`' with nothing to refer to. Rephrase it, e.g. 'Primus-Turbo declares this flydsl pin itself, but Turbo is installed with `--no-deps`, so `stage_turbo` restates it.'

**Who is affected:** Readers of `tools/installation/README.md` (the bare-metal install guide).

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**17. Comgr workaround comment describes a same-RUN hardlink while code creates a symlink in another RUN** (`.github/workflows/docker-release/Dockerfile.primus-v26.9:250`)

The comment says the `ln -f` must share a RUN with the pip install to avoid overlayfs copy-up, but the code is `ln -sf` (a symlink) in the separate `rocm-sdk init` RUN, so the inode argument doesn't apply. The same text is in `Dockerfile.jax-v26.9`. Reword the comment to describe the symlink replacement.

**Origin:** pre-existing

**Who is affected:** Maintainers reading the comgr workaround in the new v26.9 Dockerfiles; the image builds the same either way.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

</details>
